name: app-orange-medical-app-health-score-phone-with-ghost-title
title: Orange Medical App Health Score with Ghost Title
whatItIs: A white and peach cover with a giant faint 'MediCare' behind a tilted phone with an orange health score screen (82/100), a segmented progress bar and black and grey action cards, and studio, discipline and platform labels at the top.
whatItMeans: Orange gives a medical app energy and warmth, and the score screen tells the story at a glance.
techniques: Solid orange screen as the hero colour
Black and grey action tiles for contrast
Ghost name and peach glow behind
Tiny top labels naming studio and format

vocabulary.definition: A single number summarising overall health status.
A bar made of small blocks that fill in.
Small captions across the top of a cover.
